Output written. Verifying the last few citations was done inline as I read each file (base.py:995-1003, lightrag.py:3573-3586, graph_routes.py:754-756, query_routes.py:879, document_routes.py:3600-3604/3711-3731, ollama_api.py:154-157).

- **Output**: `/home/mara/cwe-bench/pipelines/stacking/out/screener-ds-rescreen/3935.json`
- **Trust decision**: raw exception text must never reach a client; enforced in the API layer by a shared `internal_server_error()` helper (generic message + error_id) across 33 handler sites plus an app-level `Exception` handler.
- **pattern_fit**: A+B — the fix spans 6 files including a second transport (`ollama_api.py`) and a helper/app-factory module, while core-produced error strings and a post-header stream error line remain uncovered.
- **Strongest lever**: reason-to-dismiss — the leak survives through a 200 domain payload (`LightRAG.aquery_data`, lightrag/lightrag.py:3578), a `DeletionResult.message` 500, and an in-band NDJSON `{"error": str(e)}`, all of which a solver can argue are "not HTTP error responses".
- **Biggest red flag**: none of the listed flags hold; the real weakness is that 31 of the 33 sites are one grep-and-replace concept (WHERE-type), so the difficulty must come entirely from the HOW-type core/stream producers.
